Time & Session Concepts · Advanced

Opening Range Gap (ORG)

A session-reference gap label appearing in some ICT transcript indexes. The exact opening session and price anchors are not universally specified, so they must be documented from the source being followed.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Specify the session opening and the prior close/range boundary that define the gap.
  2. Record exchange, instrument expiry, session and chart timezone.
  3. Do not confuse it with a conventional opening-range breakout or NDOG/NWOG.
  4. Observe price interaction without assuming the gap must fill.
Use only when the exact source definition and futures-session anchor are written down.

Common mistakes and limitations

Assuming all educators mean the same ORG; transferring forex session assumptions to futures without checking exchange hours.
